plugins.name: benchmark-agent
plugins.description: One general-purpose benchmark skill backed by a native engine: plan/run/tune/analyze/compare/track experiments on any system (DB, index, retriever, embedding/LLM pipeline) with fair comparison, a required-params gate, resource/OOM guardrails, a loop-guarded tuner, and honest reports. Benchmark anything via the generic CommandDomain (shell-stage DAG) or a Python Domain.
